jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About you and this role
 

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.
 

The Analytical Science team in Seneffe is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Leveraging advanced analytical technologies and deep scientific knowledge, the team partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and commercial organizations to deliver impactful solutions across a broad range of material science applications.
 

We now have an exciting opportunity for a 
Senior R&D Specialist – Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy to join our Analytical Science division in 
Seneffe, Belgium.
 

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges. 

• Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities. 

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance. 

• Drive innovation through the application of advanced analytical techniques and scientific problem solving. 

• Share technical expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to capability building within the Analytical Sciences community. 

• Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines.  

Qualifications
 
 

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 

• Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR. 

• Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis. 

• Proven track record of applying analytical science to solve complex technical challenges. 

• Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs. 

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 

• Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage.  

Additional Notes
 
 

• This position does not offer relocation assistance 

• Please submit your application in English to be eligible for consideration in the selection process.  

 

Benefits – What Dow offers you
 

We invest in you.
 

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
 

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
 
 

• Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 

• Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 

• Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. 
 

• Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).   

• Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). 
 

• Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.   

• Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. 

• Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 

• Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 

• Competitive yearly vacation allowance. 

• Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). 

• Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. 

• Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 

• Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. 

• On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). 

• Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. 

• Additionally, some of our locations might offer: 
 

• Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location) 

• Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location) 

• Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)    

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

jobs.occupation: Business development manager DACH region - fixed contract
jobs.description:
Searching for a job in sales?

Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

The company is Belgium based, but are you willing to travel extensively within the DACH region?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a business development manager who will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities across the German-speaking market (Dach region: Germany, Austria and Switzerland). You will play a pivotal role in expanding the company’s footprint, strengthening relationships with distributors in various markets.

• You will identify and pursue new business opportunities within the DACH region.

• Relationships with distributors and resellers will you build and maintain.

• For accounts in this region, you will serve as the primary point of contact.

• You will develop tailored solutions and proposals to meet specific customer needs.

• The market trends and competitor activities will you analyze to identify growth opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

• At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the industrial or manufacturing sectors.

• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).

• Strong understanding of the DACH market and cultural nuances.

• Proven ability to develop and maintain client relationships.

• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decision-making.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and CRM tools.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.

• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.

• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.

• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.

• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.

• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).

• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.

• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.

• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you passionate about data and turning information into valuable business insights?

 

To strengthen our Business Intelligence team, we are looking for a SAP Data & Analytics Consultant. In this role, you will help shape our data-driven future by designing and implementing reporting and analytics solutions across the Joris Ide division.

Your responsibilities

• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analytics solutions within the SAP ecosystem.
• Translate business requirements into data models, queries, views, reports and dashboards.
• Work closely with stakeholders across different departments and business levels to understand their reporting needs.
• Implement pragmatic and scalable BI solutions for all companies within the Joris Ide division.
• Support the transition towards a data-driven organisation by promoting Business Intelligence best practices.
• Ensure data quality, consistency and usability across reporting environments.
• Contribute to continuous improvements within our BI landscape and processes.

Your profile

• You have a strong analytical mindset and a conceptual way of thinking.
• You enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
• You take initiative and are eager to learn and explore new technologies.
• You have excellent communication skills and can translate business needs into technical solutions.
• You are customer-oriented, result-driven and committed to quality.
• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
• You hold a degree in IT, Business or a related field.
• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business Intelligence, including data modelling, master data management and ETL processes.
• You have strong knowledge of:
• SAP Business Data Cloud
• SAP Datasphere
• SAP Analytics Cloud
• Experience with SAP BusinessObjects, SAP BW and SAP HANA Views is considered a plus.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is an asset.Persoonsgebonden competenties (soft skills):
• Analyseren
• Digitaal denken
• Initiatief
• Plannen en organiseren
• Samenwerken

What will you do?

In this role, you combine headhunting top talent with actively building your own client portfolio. You will have the unique opportunity to write our success story in Zaventem right from the ground floor:

• 

Build Your Business: Proactively reach out to corporate clients across the region to map out their recruitment needs and develop long-lasting business partnerships.

• 

Find & Connect: Target and headhunt top talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, modern AI tools, and our existing network.

• 

Assess & Match: Conduct in-depth interviews to uncover candidates' career ambitions and match them with the right company culture.

• 

Drive Results: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from start to finish — from initial client acquisition to contract negotiation and candidate onboarding.

     
Who are you?

No prior recruitment background? That’s completely fine! We look for professionals with the right mindset and strong commercial instinct.

• 

Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (in any field).

• 

Language Skills: You are fluent in French and have a strong professional command of English. Good knowledge of Dutch is a clear advantage for our office dynamic.

• 

Commercial Drive: You are target-oriented, proactive on the phone, and motivated by tangible financial and professional growth.

• 

Profile: You combine sharp business acumen with high energy, resilience, and a drive to win.

As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

Requirements

• Valid Category B driving licence (mandatory).
• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.
• Able to work independently while maintaining high quality standards.
• Physically fit, as the role involves loading and unloading electric scooters.
Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in logistics, deliveries or transportation.
• Interest in electric vehicles or sustainable mobility.
• Experience in the mobility, automotive or technical sector is a plus.
• Good knowledge of Brussels and surrounding areas.
Languages

• Good command of English and French.
• Dutch is an advantage but is not required. 
What We Offer

• 6-month full-time contract (38 hours per week), with the possibility of a permanent contract (CDI) based on performance and business needs.
• A dynamic and fast-growing company.
• A young, international and supportive team.
• A varied role with a high level of autonomy.
• Competitive salary based on experience, plus additional benefits.
